mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_at, o.total_price, AS display_status, o.app_at, MAX(od.store_at) AS store_at FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, o.total_price, o.app_at

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY od.orer_detail_id) AS row_no, od.order_detail_id, i.ingredient_name, od.order_quantity, i.order_unit, od.supply_price, od.order_price, u.user_name FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY od.order_detail_id
